Kitty Kitty Kitty Kitty 😻 If you like my music and my videos, please follow and share! 😁 I originally wrote these bars back in 2010. When I first tried bringing it to life in 2012, this track started out as a rap rock track with my band Adversity Breeds Creation with AJ Lee on keys and Gregg Popkriefka (Bloody Reunion/Power Syndicate) on guitar, however at that time ABC was wrapping up and the song never got to see the light of day. During the pandemic, I started licensing beats with the intention of starting my solo artist musical journey. This track from Legion Beats featuring a hook by Vidal Garcia was one of the first beats I licensed and I felt the vibe matched the vibe of my bars, I just had to add a section to each of the 3 verses to line it all up. 🎤 Now, I’ve finally finished setting up my home studio and am looking to start recording all the tracks I’ve written and have been working on. This track has been waiting far too long and will definitely be one of the 1st tracks I lay down. I can’t wait to share this and the rest of my music and get this project off the ground. I’m a rapper and singer looking for my audience so if you could please follow and share my videos, that would be amazing! 🤩 I truly appreciate your engagement as that’s what’s going to help me achieve my dreams so please like, comment and follow for more! 🙏😁 Peace ✌️ and one love ❤️

This viral video features a confrontation in a retail store between a customer and an employee named Tiara. The customer is arguing with her, and she reacts in a way that has made the clip famous for her calm, yet "unphased" demeanor. Key Moments in the Video The Argument: The customer is shouting at the employee, claiming she is "nothing but a manager". The Correction: The customer zooms in on her T-Mobile name tag, which actually says her name is Tiara and her title is "Retail Sales Associate". Breaking the 4th Wall: While the customer is yelling and threatening to "choke" her, Tiara looks directly into the camera lens with a deadpan, unimpressed expression. The Comeback: She calmly repeats, "Who is she gonna choke? You better get up out my face because you're failing to realize your job position". Why It's Popular The video is often shared with the caption "Shorty broke the 4th wall mid-beef" because of how Tiara ignores the shouting customer and looks right at the viewers, as if she is on a reality TV show. Her refusal to get angry or "stressed" by the customer's aggression is why viewers describe her as "not phased".

Superbad: A Loud, Sincere Tribute to Adolescent Chaos Put on your seatbelt for one epic, hilariously crazy night in the suburban jungle. Superbad is more than just a raucous comedy; it's a cringe-inducing, finely calibrated symphony of teenage anxiety, a gut-bustingly comic, surprisingly poignant monument to the desperate quest of intimacy, popularity, and partying. Our mentors are the wonderfully mismatched, codependent pair of Seth and Evan, a sweet-natured, neurotic superego and a loud-mouthed, id-driven id, portrayed with flawless, heartbreaking sincerity by Jonah Hill and Michael Cera. Their hunt for alcohol turns into a wildly unpredictable, law-evading odyssey, made possible by the unintentionally renowned McLovin with the phony ID. The film is a time-capsule-perfect tapestry of discomfort from the mid-2000s, driven by fast-paced, infinitely quotable language and embarrassingly realistic moments of social disaster. Beneath the hormone-driven, foul-mouthed frenzy, however, is a very sad heart that captures the bittersweet, transitional ache of a friendship on the verge of transformation. A timeless classic that discovers deep truth while having fun. #superbad #movimento #movieclips #cinematographer #filming

光纖電纜，也稱為光纜，是一種類似電纜的組件，但其中包含一根或多根用於傳輸光訊號的光纖。光纖通常單獨塗覆塑膠層，並封裝在適用於電纜使用環境的保護管內。不同類型的電纜用於不同的光纖通訊應用，例如長途通訊或在建築物的不同部分之間提供高速資料連接。光纖由纖芯和包層組成，兩者折射率不同，因此具有全內反射特性。在實際應用中，包層通常會塗覆一層丙烯酸酯聚合物或聚醯亞胺。這種塗層可以保護光纖免受損傷，但不會改變其光波導特性。單一塗覆的光纖（或製成帶狀或束狀的光纖）周圍會擠出一層堅韌的樹脂緩衝層或芯管，形成電纜纖芯。根據應用的不同，還會添加多層保護套，最終形成完整的電纜。剛性光纖組件有時會在光纖之間放置吸光（「暗」）玻璃，以防止從一根光纖洩漏的光進入另一根光纖。#日本 #知识 #事实 #你知道吗 #推荐 #科技 #创新 #历史 #技术 #实验 #热门

光纖電纜，也稱為光纜，是一種類似電纜的組件，但其中包含一根或多根用於傳輸光訊號的光纖。光纖通常單獨塗覆塑膠層，並封裝在適用於電纜使用環境的保護管內。不同類型的電纜用於不同的光纖通訊應用，例如長途通訊或在建築物的不同部分之間提供高速資料連接。光纖由纖芯和包層組成，兩者折射率不同，因此具有全內反射特性。在實際應用中，包層通常會塗覆一層丙烯酸酯聚合物或聚醯亞胺。這種塗層可以保護光纖免受損傷，但不會改變其光波導特性。單一塗覆的光纖（或製成帶狀或束狀的光纖）周圍會擠出一層堅韌的樹脂緩衝層或芯管，形成電纜纖芯。根據應用的不同，還會添加多層保護套，最終形成完整的電纜。剛性光纖組件有時會在光纖之間放置吸光（「暗」）玻璃，以防止從一根光纖洩漏的光進入另一根光纖。#日本 #知识 #事实 #你知道吗 #推荐 #科技 #创新 #历史 #技术 #实验 #热门

Duke football took a devastating blow just hours before the closure of the transfer portal, with quarterback Darian Mensah reportedly announcing his intentions to seek opportunities elsewhere. The star quarterback had previously posted an Instagram video announcing his intention to remain with the Blue Devils for the 2026 season, which quieted rumors that he might declare for the NFL draft. Friday morning, sources reported that Duke officials had concerns about Mensah’s portal entrance, despite a supposedly airtight contract that would leave his exclusive NIL rights tied up at Duke. Later in the afternoon, ESPN’s Pete Thamel reported that Mensah informed the program of his decision to enter the portal. Mensah is coming off an impressive redshirt sophomore season, where he racked up 3,973 passing yards and 34 passing touchdowns with the Blue Devils to lead the conference in both categories. His contract — reportedly $4 million annually for two years — generated substantial buzz when Duke picked him up from Tulane in the portal last year. Duke will now have to locate a new starting quarterback. If it doesn’t grab a piece from the portal, it figures to be a battle between redshirt freshman Dan Mahan and incoming freshman Terry Walker III for the job. Ethnicity with n word pass usually refers to the idea, mostly discussed online, that only certain people—specifically Black or African American individuals—are considered “allowed” to use the n word due to its historical context of oppression, slavery, and systemic racism The term “pass” is slang for permission, but it is controversial because it highlights that usage by people outside the Black community is widely considered offensive and unacceptable The concept appears in memes, social media discussions, and debates about race, language, and cultural sensitivity It emphasizes the weight and history of the word and why context and identity matter When people talk about an “n word pass,” they are often joking or critiquing the idea of selective permission, but it underscores that the word carries serious historical and social consequences

Elephant seals are the largest seal species on the planet, with adult males weighing up to 4,000 kg (9,000 lbs) and growing over 6 meters (20 feet) long. Their name comes from the large, inflatable nose — or proboscis — that males use to amplify vocalizations during dominance displays. Despite their size, elephant seals are elite divers. They regularly plunge over 1,500 meters (nearly a mile) deep and can hold their breath for up to two hours, spending as much as 90% of their lives at sea hunting squid and fish in the deep ocean. On land, males battle violently for control of breeding beaches, while females raise their pups during a brief but intense breeding season. Afterward, both sexes return to the ocean for months at a time, disappearing into the open sea. Built for pressure, endurance, and extremes — elephant seals are among the most impressive marine mammals on Earth. #oceanlife #marinemammals #wildlife #nature #explore

Basketball wasn’t always the plan for Jarrett Allen: “I wasn’t one of these kids who had a basketball in his crib, or was dunking on a plastic hoop at age two or whatever. I wasn’t a prodigy. As a little kid, I barely even played hoops. I was more into Pokemon and Zelda. (Wind Waker … very underrated masterpiece, by the way.) When I was six or seven, I went to this rec center with my brother, and my very first shot ever in life, I run up to the basket all excited, toss the ball up at the rim and…. Clank ……… It hits off the bottom of the rim, ricochets back, and — WAP!!!!! — nails me square in the face. Knocked on my ass. Down for the count. After one shot, I retired on the spot. I swore I was done. I only kept playing because it was a chance to hang out with my friends. And I didn’t take the game all that seriously. I was never practicing to become a superstar, or even really to get good. I would just go to practice because that’s what the kids I knew did. But I would’ve rather been doing something else. I was really into the whole video game universe back then. (Still am!) So it was lots of this one Ninja Turtles game on the PS2, or any of the Zelda games (except Skyward Sword, which I have real issues with, as a purist). Basically anything but sports games. (The only sports game I had as a kid was 2K12, and only because I was achievement hunting at the time.) Beyond that, there was a lot of Boomerang Network — shout out to Yosemite Sam, Thundercats, and Duck Dodgers! — and Courage the Cowardly Dog and, most of all … The Twilight Zone.... Other kids were maybe watching Kobe or Dirk highlights all day. But me? I’d be holed up watching some weird Twilight Zone episode.... So … yeah. It’s maybe no surprise that I didn’t really know I was any good at basketball until very late. I was more concerned with … other things. It took until sometime around my junior year in high school for me to realize I had some talent. And then, three years later, I was in the NBA.” (Link in bio) • 📸: @pixelatebyjasonmiller, @joemurphyphoto

Not being invited to parties or events can feel like standing on the outside of a window, watching everyone else laugh and move together while you’re stuck in the quiet. There’s a sting that comes with realizing plans were made without you, even if no one meant to hurt you. It can make you question your place—whether you’re forgettable, unimportant, or simply not wanted—and those thoughts can echo louder than the actual silence of a free night. What hurts most isn’t always missing the event itself, but missing the feeling of being thought of. Over time, that feeling can sink deeper, turning into self-doubt or a sense of invisibility. You might start wondering what you did wrong, or what you should change, even when the situation has more to do with circumstance than worth. Yet, in that loneliness, there’s also a quiet awareness of what you want: connection that feels real, invitations that feel genuine. Not being invited can hurt, but it also reveals how much belonging matters—and how meaningful it will feel when you find people who choose you without hesitation. #relatable #reels

The Petronas Twin Towers were not built together, they were built as a race. To speed up construction, two different international teams were hired. A Japanese consortium was assigned to one tower, while a South Korean consortium built the other. Both worked independently, using the same design but separate crews, schedules, and management. Delays were extremely costly, estimated at around $700,000 per day, which turned the project into a quiet competition. The South Korean team ultimately finished their tower first. Despite being built separately, the towers had to meet precisely at the skybridge, requiring extreme accuracy in height, alignment, and structural tolerance. What makes the show interesting isn’t just the music or comedy, but how Tori constantly lands in unpredictable situations with classmates who are far more eccentric than she ever expected. For generations, farmers in the dense highlands of Jinotega, Nicaragua have whispered of strange, goblin-like beings that emerge from the mist-shrouded mountains under moonlight. Livestock goes missing without a trace—no blood, no tracks, just silence by morning. Locals claim these small, leathery-skinned creatures move in groups, their eyes glowing a dim green as they scavenge for food or mischief. The old timers say they’ve lived there for centuries, long before the first settlers, dwelling in hidden caves carved deep into the volcanic rock. What if the tales aren’t just folklore? What if these so-called “duendes del monte” are remnants of something ancient—an undiscovered species adapted to the remote jungle valleys of Nicaragua? Modern skeptics dismiss the stories, but strange sounds echoing through the fog and half-eaten animal carcasses left in impossible places keep the rumors alive. Reports are circulating of a towering, winged figure seen stalking the foggy banks and back roads of Indiana late at night described as humanoid, dark as shadow, with massive wings and piercing red eyes. The sighting instantly revived the legend of the Mothman, a cryptid made famous by encounters in Point Pleasant, West Virginia during the 1960s, where witnesses claimed it appeared before tragic events. According to folklore, Mothman stands over seven feet tall, moves with unnatural speed, and radiates an overwhelming sense of dread. Over the decades, encounters have been reported across the Midwest—hovering near bridges, power plants, and isolated highways often followed by strange dreams, missing time, or unexplained mechanical failures. 《星球大战》系列中最著名的一幕，出现在电影**《帝国反击战》**中，那就是卢克·天行者与达斯·维达的正面对决。在云城所在的贝斯平行星那阴暗而压抑的环境中，这场光剑决斗成为了影史上最令人难忘的场景之一。 这一幕充满了紧张感：年轻且经验不足的绝地武士卢克，面对的是象征黑暗原力的强大存在——达斯·维达。战斗节奏紧凑、画面震撼，但真正让这场戏载入史册的，是它的结尾。在关键时刻，维达揭示了自己与卢克之间的真实关系，这一真相彻底改变了整个故事的意义，也震撼了片中的角色和全世界的观众。 这一情节反转成为流行文化中最具代表性的瞬间之一。这一场景不仅深化了人物形象和善与恶之间的冲突，也证明了《星球大战》不仅仅是一部太空冒险电影，更是一部关于家庭、选择与后果的故事。直到今天，它仍然被不断引用、模仿和致敬，被公认为电影史上最伟大的剧情反转之一。 🌌⚔️

Basketball is a thrilling sport that blends speed, skill, and strategy, and few players have embodied its spirit as completely as Kobe Bryant. Known as one of the greatest basketball players in history, Kobe’s influence reached far beyond the hardwood. Born in 1978, he entered the NBA straight out of high school and spent his entire 20-year career with the Los Angeles Lakers, where his relentless work ethic, competitive fire, and dedication to excellence became legendary. Nicknamed the “Black Mamba,” Kobe developed a mindset centered on discipline, focus, and self-belief—qualities that inspired millions of athletes worldwide. On the court, he was a master of footwork, mid-range shooting, and clutch performances, leading the Lakers to five NBA championships and earning two Finals MVP awards and an NBA MVP in 2008. Yet, his impact extended well beyond basketball; he was a mentor, storyteller, and advocate for youth sports, emphasizing hard work and resilience. Even after retiring in 2016, Kobe continued to inspire through his creative ventures, including his Oscar-winning short film *Dear Basketball*. His tragic death in 2020, alongside his daughter Gianna, deeply affected the global basketball community, reminding fans of his lasting legacy of passion, perseverance, and excellence. Today, Kobe Bryant remains a symbol of what it means to chase greatness with unwavering determination, leaving behind a legacy that continues to motivate future generations both on and off the court.
